A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a quark triplet is not a free particle, but it is a bound state of three quarks, the three quarks being in the same quantum state.
the four-fermi interaction is compatible with the leading singularities of the light-cone current commutators but the detailed structure of the bilocals is essentially changed.

The main takeaway from our work is that
a non-trivial light-cone structure is a necessary condition for the existence of quark confinement.
